editorial:
Imagine heading to a beautiful beach getaway with your best friends for a week of partying and sun. That is exactly how things start here, but the vibe shifts fast. You get to follow a group of friends who think they are in for the trip of their lives on Fire Island. At first, it feels like a typical vacation movie with plenty of flirting and drama. But as the drinks flow and secrets come out, the party turns into a nightmare. You will feel the tension build as the group realizes someone among them is a cold-blooded killer, turning their paradise into a trap.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing about who is lying. The acting feels natural, and the twists come at just the right time to keep you awake. While some parts of the plot are a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you love a good whodunit with a scary edge, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the killer is finally revealed to be one of the friends who felt betrayed by the group. In a final struggle on the beach, the truth about the lies and affairs comes out. Most of the group manages to escape, but the killer meets a brutal end. The movie wraps up by showing that the perfect vacation ruined their lives forever, leaving the survivors scarred by the blood spilled in paradise.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves murder mysteries and beachy settings.
